summary: No update needed. The page’s local build, search, and deployment instructions match the site package, Docusaurus configuration, and checked-in workflows. It already distinguishes configured deployment behavior from current server state and requires checking the deployment result and public revision marker. Product evidence supports the public-main dispatch in the docs-sync workflow, the proposal and human-acceptance design in ADR 0048’s Decision and Consequences sections, and the initial reconciliation, checkpoint, PR, and merge flow in the Documentation automation section of the publication guide. These sources describe documented behavior and design; they do not establish a successful current publication.
